'''Null-gee sleeping plates''' were a luxury technology. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hawra]]'s personal quarters at the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Technical Branch Outpost (Lotide)|Technical Branch Outpost]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] planet of [[Lotide]] were equipped with the latest in null-gee sleeping plates, along with plush carpeting and soothing subsonics.<ref name="BI">[[Black Ice (adventure)|''Black Ice'']]</ref>
